ITEM TEXT
Many
papers
you
write
in
college
will
require
you
to
include
quotes
from
one
or
more
sources
.
Even
if
you
don't
have
to
do
it
,
integrating
a
few
quotes
into
your
writing
can
add
life
and
persuasiveness
to
your
arguments
.
The
key
is
to
use
quotes
to
support
a
point
you're
trying
to
make
rather
than
just
include
them
to
fill
the
space
.
